ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/grey pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe exhibits a dominant black base with a high density of small, high-intensity circular and ring-shaped blobs. Right lobe displays a dominant black base with a localized group of high-intensity vertical linear bands in the medial-distal quadrant and circular ring-shaped clusters near the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys visible along the continuous linear boundaries of both lobes; more pronounced and jagged near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward curvature with an increasing geometric slope approaching the distal apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular and elliptical white-on-black rings across the majority of the left lobe and the distal portion of the right lobe, indicating dense localized pixel clusters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct series of parallel, vertical high-intensity linear markings (rake-like features) on the medial section of the right lobe lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring and a prominent sequence of parallel linear vertical abrasions on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific intersection of vertical linear banding and high-density circular scarring on the right lobe creates a unique geometric grid pattern not observed on the left lobe.
